renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 (0x00002F04) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

settings.source: browser WebGL realtime — not Unreal Engine

sleeve.note: Original continuous sleeve fitted offscreen; no joined material, wrists/grip unchanged

weapon.animation: baseline root recoil/reload + cosmetic magazine/handle; source held pose baked with rear sleeve fit, original fabric and grip retained; not a full reload animation

actors.author: DanlyVostok
actors.animation: blended procedural skeleton; world-planted two-bone leg IK, weapon-relative arm IK, pelvis/spine weight, aim, crouch, lean, breathing and actual-shot recoil; not motion capture
actors.combat: original anchors, life, hit proxies, wg2 and gunTip transforms are never written
actors.input: update(dt,{live,pres}); enemy.tactical visual state; phase uses measured anchor displacement
actors.stance: consume caller-smoothed stance directly; full crouch lowers the skin by 0.57m to approximately 1.23m
actors.muzzle: flash is a child of the unchanged gunTip; triggered only by a rising tactical.recoil
actors.integration: caller owns weapon height/pitch/recoil and hit posture; pose before sampling the combat muzzle

storm.ground: Poly Haven asphalt_02, 2K albedo / OpenGL normal / roughness
storm.sky: Poly Haven approaching_storm, HDR photograph + moving procedural density
storm.interiors: four legacy parallax facades; MERCADO12 is a genuine enterable timber room
storm.lightning: bounded slow single events; reduced-flash switch disables bolt and light pulse
storm.weaponAudio: preserved CC0 recorded AR-15/M4 clips; not an SMG field recording
storm.environmentAudio: independently synthesized rain/wind/thunder, not field recordings

impacts.method: shared-wet-pixels / instanced rings, crowns and ballistic droplets

ambientAudio.method: synthesized noise, not a field recording

house.reference: user supplied timber cabin; structure only, no photo/watermark copied

features: masked planar water reflection and rain rings
photographic storm sky and moving cloud layer
reference-led enterable timber house and hinged door

mode: scripted real combat via original movement/fire/reload/AI, auto-restart after outcomes
